title: Remote desktop
verify: Allow only after both computers show the same code: {{code}}
displayUnavailable: Display switching did not finish. The current screen is retained.
recovering: Restoring the screen. Input control is paused…
REMOTE_CLIPBOARD_BUSY: Another clipboard request is still pending. Try again shortly.
audioUnavailable: System audio is unavailable. Check the output device and recording permissions.
videoFallback: Video decoding is unavailable. Using compatible screen images.
signIn: Sign in through Account center first
intro: Choose a Windows PC or Mac on your account. Screen and input access begins after approval on that computer.
keyboardHint: Click the screen to control it. Press Esc to release the keyboard.

scaling.label: Screen scaling
scaling.browseHint: Drag or scroll to browse locally without controlling the remote computer. Press Esc to resume control.

text: Type text on the remote computer
textHint: Supports Unicode. Clipboard contents are never read or synchronized.

clipboard.unavailable: The clipboard operation was not confirmed. Check the remote state and system permissions.
clipboard.tooLarge: The clipboard supports plain text up to 48 KB.
clipboard.expired: The clipboard request timed out. Check the remote state before trying again.

failed: The remote connection was interrupted. Connect again.

end.stopped: The other computer ended the remote session.
end.declined: The other computer declined the control request.
end.expired: The control request expired. Connect again.
end.disconnected: The other computer disconnected. Input control has stopped. Connect again.
end.deviceRevoked: A participating device was removed. Remote control has stopped.
end.captureFailed: Screen capture stopped on the other computer. Check screen recording permission and connect again.
end.inputFailed: Input control stopped on the other computer. Check system permissions and connect again.

REMOTE_CAPTURE_FAILED: Screen capture is unavailable. On Mac, allow screen recording in System Settings and retry.
REMOTE_INPUT_FAILED: Input control is unavailable. On Mac, allow Accessibility in System Settings. Windows cannot control elevated windows.
REMOTE_BUSY: One of the computers already has a remote session. End it first.
REMOTE_ENDED: The request expired or the session ended. Connect again.
REMOTE_UNSUPPORTED: Remote desktop currently supports Windows and macOS.
